```{r Compute EPI: Biodiversity and Habitat Sub-index}
Nature_Data <- read_excel("QData.xlsx", sheet = "Nature")

# EPI Biodiversity & Habitat Sub-index (BDH): weighted average of 8 sub-indicators.
# Raw weights from the 2024 EPI methodology, normalised to sum to 1:
#   MKP  Marine KBA Protection          0.12  -> 0.146
#   MHP  Marine Habitat Protection      0.12  -> 0.146
#   MPE  Marine Protection Stringency   0.02  -> 0.024
#   SPI  Species Protection Index       0.16  -> 0.195
#   TBN  Terrestrial Biome Protection   0.10  -> 0.122
#   TKP  Terrestrial KBA Protection     0.10  -> 0.122
#   RLI  Red List Index                 0.12  -> 0.146
#   SHI  Species Habitat Index          0.08  -> 0.098

bdh_raw_weights <- c(MKP = 0.12, MHP = 0.12, MPE = 0.02, SPI = 0.16,
                     TBN = 0.10, TKP = 0.10, RLI = 0.12, SHI = 0.08)
bdh_norm_weights <- bdh_raw_weights / sum(bdh_raw_weights)

Nature_Data <- Nature_Data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    BDH_computed = {
      vals <- c_across(all_of(names(bdh_raw_weights)))
      avail <- !is.na(vals)
      if (sum(avail) == 0) NA_real_
      else sum(vals[avail] * bdh_norm_weights[avail]) / sum(bdh_norm_weights[avail])
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

validation_bdh <- Nature_Data %>%
  filter(!is.na(BDH) & !is.na(BDH_computed)) %>%
  mutate(diff = abs(BDH - BDH_computed))
cat("BDH validation: max diff =", max(validation_bdh$diff),
    "| n =", nrow(validation_bdh), "\n")

Nature_Data <- Nature_Data %>%
  mutate(BDH = coalesce(BDH, BDH_computed)) %>%
  select(-BDH_computed)

cat("BDH coverage:", sum(!is.na(Nature_Data$BDH)), "of", nrow(Nature_Data), "rows\n")
```

## Annual Sample Construction

```{r Annual Sample}
# Take Q1 of each year as the annual observation. Slow-moving environmental
# indicators (BII, BDH, BHI, NDGAIN) are observed annually and reported in Q1
# of the source spreadsheet, so this preserves all original (pre-interpolation)
# environmental data points.
AData <- QData %>%
  filter(Q == 1) %>%
  arrange(ISO3, Year)

cat("Annual sample: ", nrow(AData), "country-year rows across",
    length(unique(AData$ISO3)), "countries.\n")
```

## Mutate Variables
```{r Rename and Mutate Variables}
AData <- AData %>%
  mutate(
    Inv_BII = 100 - BII,
    Inv_BDH = 100 - BDH,
    ln_WBRNC = log(WBNCR),
    Inv_BHI = 100 - BHI,
    Inv_BHISpecies = 100 - BHISpecies,
    Inv_BHIAvg = 100 - BHIAvg,
    `BII_Vul_TC` = Inv_BII * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHIAvg_Vul` = Inv_BHIAvg * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHI_Vul` = Inv_BHI * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHISpecies_Vul` = Inv_BHISpecies * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `RNC/TC` = WBNCR/WBTC,
    BII_Vul_TC_Test = Inv_BII * `RNC/TC`,
    DebtGDP = DebtGDP/100
  )

AData <- AData %>%
  rename(GDP = `WB GDP`, ChinnIto = `Chinn-Ito`,
         EPI = Inv_BDH, NDGAIN = Vulnerability,
         WB_Classification = `WB Classification`,
         IMF_Classification = `IMF Classification`)

# Re-scale weighted indices to 0-100
AData <- AData %>%
  mutate(
    max_BII_Vul_TC = max(BII_Vul_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_BHIAvg_Vul = max(BHIAvg_Vul, na.rm = TRUE),
    BII_Weighted = (BII_Vul_TC / max_BII_Vul_TC) * 100,
    BHI_Weighted = (BHIAvg_Vul / max_BHIAvg_Vul) * 100,
    max_BII_Vul_TC = NULL,
    max_BHIAvg_Vul = NULL,
    WGI_CC = WGI_CC + 2.5,
    WGI_GE = WGI_GE + 2.5,
    WGI_RL = WGI_RL + 2.5,
    WGI_IQ = (WGI_CC + WGI_GE + WGI_RL) / 3
  )

# Standardise main regressors to unit within-country variance
vars_to_standardize <- c(
  "BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "EPI", "NDGAIN",
  "Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP",
  "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food"
)

within_sds_map <- AData %>%
  group_by(ISO3) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize), ~ . - mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize), ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  as.list()

AData <- AData %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize),
                ~ . / within_sds_map[[cur_column()]]))

cat("Calculated within-country standard deviations for standardization:\n")
print(within_sds_map)

# Lag generation (annual: L1 = 1 year, L2 = 2 years).
# Naming preserved as _L1/_L2 so model formulas mirror the quarterly script;
# interpretation differs (1 year vs 1 quarter).
AData <- AData %>%
  group_by(ISO3) %>%
  mutate(
    BII_Weighted_L1 = dplyr::lag(BII_Weighted, 1),
    BII_Weighted_L2 = dplyr::lag(BII_Weighted, 2),
    BHI_Weighted_L1 = dplyr::lag(BHI_Weighted, 1),
    BHI_Weighted_L2 = dplyr::lag(BHI_Weighted, 2),
    EPI_L1 = dplyr::lag(EPI, 1),
    EPI_L2 = dplyr::lag(EPI, 2),
    NDGAIN_L1 = dplyr::lag(NDGAIN, 1),
    NDGAIN_L2 = dplyr::lag(NDGAIN, 2),
    ER_t1 = dplyr::lead(ER, n = 1)
  ) %>%
```

## IFE Models
```{r Interactive Fixed Effects}
# Prepare base data for interFE (requires numeric panel index)
AData_IFE <- as.data.frame(AData_Final)
AData_IFE$Year <- as.numeric(as.factor(AData_IFE$Year))
AData_IFE$ISO3 <- as.character(AData_IFE$ISO3)

# Manual test
cols_needed <- c("TwoYrSpread", "BHI_Weighted", "Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP", "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "ISO3", "YearQtr", "CPI_Food")
AData_IFE_Test <- AData_IFE[cols_needed]
# 3. Drop rows with ANY missing values in these columns
AData_IFE_Test <- na.omit(AData_IFE_Test)
FiveBII_IFE <- interFE(TwoYrSpread ~ BHI_Weighted + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food, data = AData_IFE_Test, index = c("ISO3", "YearQtr"),  r =2,  force = "unit", nboots = 150, seed = 1)

# Headline IFE grid: 3 DVs x 4 IVs x {k=1, k=2}
# interFE() uses argument r; object names use k to avoid confusion with R-squared.
dependent_vars   <- c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread")
independent_vars <- c("BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "NDGAIN", "EPI")
controls         <- c("Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP",
                      "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food")

run_ife_grid <- function(k_factors) {
  results <- list()
  for (dv in dependent_vars) {
    for (iv in independent_vars) {
      model_name <- paste(dv, iv, sep = "_")
      message(paste("Running IFE k=", k_factors, ":", model_name))

      formula_str <- paste(dv, "~", iv, "+", paste(controls, collapse = " + "))
      cols_needed <- c(dv, iv, controls, "ISO3", "Year")

      missing_cols <- setdiff(cols_needed, names(AData_IFE))
      if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
        warning(paste("Missing columns for", model_name, ":",
                      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "- skipping"))
        next
      }

      data_subset <- na.omit(AData_IFE[, cols_needed])
      if (nrow(data_subset) < 50) {
        warning(paste("Insufficient data for", model_name, "- skipping"))
        next
      }

      fit <- tryCatch({
        interFE(
          formula = as.formula(formula_str),
          data    = data_subset,
          index   = c("ISO3", "Year"),
          r       = k_factors,
          force   = "unit",
          nboots  = 1000,
          se      = TRUE,
          seed    = 1,
          normalize = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(paste("Error in", model_name, ":", e$message)); NULL
      })

      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        results[[model_name]] <- fit
        print(paste("--- Results for", model_name, "(k=", k_factors, ") ---"))
        print(fit$est.table)
      }
    }
  }
  results
}

ife_results_k1_list <- run_ife_grid(1)
ife_results_k2_list <- run_ife_grid(2)
ife_results_k0_list <- run_ife_grid(0)

saveRDS(ife_results_k1_list, file = "ife_results_k1_annual.rds")
saveRDS(ife_results_k2_list, file = "ife_results_k2_annual.rds")
saveRDS(ife_results_k0_list, file = "ife_results_k0_annual.rds")

# Reload helper (use after a full run, or skip the loops above)
# ife_results_k1_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k1_annual.rds")
# ife_results_k2_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k2_annual.rds")

# --- Extract ALL coefficients from IFE results ---
extract_all_ife_coefficients <- function(ife_list) {
  all_coefs <- list()
  for (model_name in names(ife_list)) {
    fit <- ife_list[[model_name]]
    if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$est.table)) {
      message(paste("Skipping", model_name, "- no coefficients found.")); next
    }
    coefs <- fit$est.table

    dv_name <- NA
    if (grepl("TwoYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "TwoYrSpread"
    if (grepl("FiveYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "FiveYrSpread"
    if (grepl("TenYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "TenYrSpread"

    iv_name <- NA
    if (grepl("BII_Weighted", model_name)) iv_name <- "BII_Weighted_L1"
    if (grepl("BHI_Weighted", model_name)) iv_name <- "BHI_Weighted_L1"
    if (grepl("NDGAIN", model_name) || grepl("Vulnerability", model_name)) iv_name <- "NDGAIN_L1"
    if (grepl("EPI", model_name)) iv_name <- "EPI_L1"

    for (var_name in rownames(coefs)) {
      est <- coefs[var_name, "Coef"]
      se  <- coefs[var_name, "S.E."]
      pv  <- coefs[var_name, "p.value"]
      cl  <- coefs[var_name, "CI.lower"]
      cu  <- coefs[var_name, "CI.upper"]

      sig <- case_when(
        pv < 0.01 ~ "***",
        pv < 0.05 ~ "**",
        pv < 0.1  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )

      all_coefs[[length(all_coefs) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        Dependent_Variable = dv_name,
        Independent_Variable = iv_name,
        Variable = var_name,
        Estimate = est,
        Std_Error = se,
        P_Value = pv,
        CI_Lower = cl,
        CI_Upper = cu,
        Significance = sig,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, all_coefs)
}

ife_results_k1 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k1_list)
ife_results_k2 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k2_list)
ife_results_k0 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k0_list)

# --- Within R^2 helper ---
calculate_ife_within_r2 <- function(ife_list) {
  r2_results <- data.frame()
  for (model_name in names(ife_list)) {
    fit <- ife_list[[model_name]]
    if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$est.table)) next

    Y_mat   <- fit$dat.Y
    res_mat <- fit$residuals
    obs <- !is.na(Y_mat) & !is.na(res_mat)
    obs <- obs & (Y_mat != 0 | res_mat != 0)

    Y_within <- Y_mat
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(Y_mat))) {
      idx_j <- obs[, j]
      if (any(idx_j)) {
        mu_j <- mean(Y_mat[idx_j, j], na.rm = TRUE)
        Y_within[idx_j, j] <- Y_mat[idx_j, j] - mu_j
        Y_within[!idx_j, j] <- NA
      } else {
        Y_within[, j] <- NA
      }
    }
    T_per_country <- colSums(obs, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_countries   <- sum(T_per_country > 0)
    avg_T <- mean(T_per_country[T_per_country > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

    y_within_vec <- as.numeric(Y_within[obs])
    res_vec      <- as.numeric(res_mat[obs])
    TSS_within <- sum((y_within_vec - mean(y_within_vec, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    RSS        <- sum(res_vec^2, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (TSS_within > 0) {
      R2_within <- 1 - RSS / TSS_within
      n_obs <- length(y_within_vec)
      n_covars <- nrow(fit$est.table) - 1
      Adj_R2_within <- if (n_obs > n_covars + 1)
        1 - (1 - R2_within) * ((n_obs - 1) / (n_obs - n_covars - 1)) else NA

      r2_results <- rbind(r2_results, data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        R_Squared_Within = R2_within,
        Adj_R_Squared_Within = Adj_R2_within,
        N_Obs = n_obs,
        N_Countries = n_countries,
        Avg_T = avg_T,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  r2_results
}

ife_within_r2_k1 <- calculate_ife_within_r2(ife_results_k1_list)
ife_within_r2_k2 <- calculate_ife_within_r2(ife_results_k2_list)
ife_within_r2_k0 <- calculate_ife_within_r2(ife_results_k0_list)

ife_results_k1 <- ife_results_k1 %>%
  left_join(ife_within_r2_k1 %>% select(Model, R_Squared_Within, Adj_R_Squared_Within, N_Obs, N_Countries, Avg_T), by = "Model")
ife_results_k2 <- ife_results_k2 %>%
  left_join(ife_within_r2_k2 %>% select(Model, R_Squared_Within, Adj_R_Squared_Within, N_Obs, N_Countries, Avg_T), by = "Model")
ife_results_k0 <- ife_results_k0 %>%
  left_join(ife_within_r2_k0 %>% select(Model, R_Squared_Within, Adj_R_Squared_Within, N_Obs, N_Countries, Avg_T), by = "Model")

print(ife_results_k1, max = 4000)
print(ife_results_k2, max = 4000)
print(ife_results_k0, max = 4000)
```

```{r IFE Visualisation}
# IFE Point Estimate Bar Chart (2-year spread, k=1; aligned with quarterly script)
ife_results_k1_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k1_annual.rds")
five_models <- grep("^FiveYrSpread_", names(ife_results_k1_list), value = TRUE)

all_coefs <- lapply(five_models, function(nm) {
  tbl <- as.data.frame(ife_results_k1_list[[nm]]$est.table)
  tbl$variable <- rownames(tbl)
  tbl[tbl$variable != "_const", ]
})
coefs_df <- bind_rows(all_coefs)

nature_ivs <- c("BII_Weighted_L1", "BHI_Weighted_L1", "EPI_L1", "NDGAIN_L1")
controls   <- setdiff(unique(coefs_df$variable), nature_ivs)

nature_df <- coefs_df %>%
  filter(variable %in% nature_ivs) %>%
  select(variable, Coef, CI.lower, CI.upper, p.value)

control_df <- coefs_df %>%
  filter(variable %in% controls) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(Coef = mean(Coef), CI.lower = mean(CI.lower),
            CI.upper = mean(CI.upper), p.value = mean(p.value), .groups = "drop")

ife_plot_df <- bind_rows(nature_df, control_df)

label_map <- c(
  BII_Weighted_L1 = "Biodiversity Degradation (BII)",
  BHI_Weighted_L1 = "Biodiversity Degradation (BHI)",
  EPI_L1 = "Environmental Protection (EPI)",
  NDGAIN_L1 = "Climate Vulnerability (ND-GAIN)",
  Inflation = "Inflation",
  PB = "Primary Balance",
  CA = "Current Account",
  FM_Depth = "Capital Market Depth",
  GDP = "GDP Growth",
  DebtGDP = "Debt-to-GDP",
  WGI_RL = "Rule of Law (WGI)",
  CPI_Food = "Food Price Inflation"
)
ife_plot_df$label <- label_map[ife_plot_df$variable]
ife_plot_df$sig <- ifelse(ife_plot_df$p.value < 0.01, "***",
                   ifelse(ife_plot_df$p.value < 0.05, "**",
                   ifelse(ife_plot_df$p.value < 0.1, "*", "")))
ife_plot_df$group <- ifelse(ife_plot_df$variable %in% nature_ivs,
                            "Nature / Climate Vulnerability",
                            "Domestic Macroeconomic Controls")
ife_plot_df <- ife_plot_df %>%
  arrange(group, Coef) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))

x_min <- -4; x_max <- 2
x_breaks <- seq(x_min, x_max, by = 0.2)

ggplot(ife_plot_df, aes(x = label, y = Coef, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI.lower, ymax = CI.upper), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig,

  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Nature / Climate Vulnerability" = "#2a9d8f",
                               "Domestic Macroeconomic Controls" = "#264653")) +
  labs(
    title = "Interactive Fixed Effects: Impact on 5-Year Sovereign Spreads (Annual Sample)",

    x = NULL, y = "Marginal Effect on 2-Year Yield Spread (pp)",
    fill = NULL,
```

## QIFE
```{r PCA for Factors}
# T x N spread matrix at annual frequency (Q1 observations). Filters aligned with quarterly script.
# HUN, MAR, LTU need to be removed here due to missing 2-year spread data, US serves as baseline for spreads
AData_PCA <- QData %>%
  filter(Q == 1) %>%
  filter(!(ISO3 %in% c("NAM", "TUN", "NGA", "USA", "EGY", "HUN", "MAR", "LTU")) &
         (Year >= 2000 & Year <= 2020))
AData_PCA <- AData_PCA %>%
  filter(!(CountryYear %in% c(
    "GRC2011", "GRC2012", "GRC2013", "GRC2015",
    "IRL2015", "IRL2020",
    "CHN2020",
    "TUR2000", "TUR2001", "TUR2002", "TUR2003", "TUR2004", "TUR2009",
    "LKA2015", "LKA2016",
    "UGA2020",
    "ZMB2016", "ZMB2020"
  )))

spread_matrix <- AData_PCA %>%
  select(ISO3, Year, TwoYrSpread, FiveYrSpread, TenYrSpread) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ISO3,
              values_from = c(TwoYrSpread, FiveYrSpread, TenYrSpread)) %>%
  arrange(Year)

spread_matrix <- as.matrix(spread_matrix[, -1])
spread_matrix_centered <- scale(spread_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
nb <- estim_ncpPCA(spread_matrix_centered, ncp.max = 5)
res.comp <- imputePCA(spread_matrix_centered, ncp = nb$ncp)

K1 <- pca_final$x[, 1]
K2 <- pca_final$x[, 2]
summary(pca_final)$importance

cor(K1, pca_alt$x[, 1])
```

```{r Linear Quantile Mixture Model}
# Annual robustness: no interpolation; Q1 observations only.
AData_QIFE <- as.data.frame(AData_Final)
AData_QIFE$ISO3 <- as.character(AData_QIFE$ISO3)

dependent_vars   <- c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread")
independent_vars <- c("BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "EPI", "NDGAIN")
controls         <- c("Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP",
                      "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food")
quantiles        <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
num_factors      <- c(1, 2)
R_boot           <- 500

# Function runs QIFE for all specifications and stores results in a nested list: qife_results[[dv]][[iv]][[k]][[quantile]]
run_qife_grid <- function(n_groups) {
  results <- list()
  for (dv in dependent_vars) {
    results[[dv]] <- list()
    dv_abbrev <- gsub("YrSpread", "", dv)

    for (iv in independent_vars) {
      results[[dv]][[iv]] <- list()

      for (k in num_factors) {
        results[[dv]][[iv]][[paste0("k", k)]] <- list()
        randomTC_formula <- if (k == 1) ~ 1 + K1 else ~ 1 + K1 + K2

        for (qtl in quantiles) {
          iv_abbrev <- gsub("_Weighted_L1|_L1", "", iv)
          model_name <- paste0(dv_abbrev, "_", iv_abbrev, "_K", k, "_G", n_groups,
                               "_q", gsub("\\.", "", as.character(qtl)))
          message(paste("Running:", model_name))

          formula_obj <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", iv, "+",
                                          paste(controls, collapse = " + ")))

          fit <- tryCatch({
            lqmix(
              formula = formula_obj,
              randomTC = randomTC_formula,
              group = "ISO3",
              time  = "Year",
              G = n_groups,
              data = AData_QIFE,
              qtl  = qtl,
              se   = TRUE,
              R    = R_boot,
              verbose = TRUE
            )
          }, error = function(e) {
            message(paste("Error in", model_name, ":", e$message)); NULL
          })

          if (!is.null(fit)) {
            results[[dv]][[iv]][[paste0("k", k)]][[as.character(qtl)]] <- fit
            message(paste("Completed:", model_name))
          } else {
            message(paste("Failed:", model_name))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  results
}

# Run QIFE for factors 1, 2, all quantiles, EVs and DVs, but separately for each number of groups (G=3, 4, or 5)
qife_results_G3 <- run_qife_grid(3)
qife_results_G4 <- run_qife_grid(4)
qife_results_G5 <- run_qife_grid(5)


# Save accordingly
saveRDS(qife_results_G3, file = "qife_results_annual_G3.rds")
saveRDS(qife_results_G4, file = "qife_results_annual_G4.rds")
saveRDS(qife_results_G5, file = "qife_results_annual_G5.rds")

# Reload helper (use after a full run, or skip the loops above)
# qife_results_G3 <- readRDS("qife_results_annual_G3.rds")
# qife_results_G4 <- readRDS("qife_results_annual_G4.rds")
# qife_results_G5 <- readRDS("qife_results_annual_G5.rds")

extract_qife_coefficients <- function(qife_results_list, g = NA) {
  all_coefs <- list()
  for (dv in names(qife_results_list)) {
    for (iv in names(qife_results_list[[dv]])) {
      for (k_nm in names(qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]])) {
        for (qtl_str in names(qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]][[k_nm]])) {
          model <- qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]][[k_nm]][[qtl_str]]
          if (is.null(model)) next

          model_summary <- tryCatch(summary(model), error = function(e) NULL)
          coef_table <- NULL
          if (!is.null(model_summary) && !is.null(model_summary$fix)) {
            coef_table <- model_summary$fix
          }
          if (is.null(coef_table) && !is.null(model$betaf) && !is.null(model$se.betaf)) {
            coef_table <- cbind(Estimate = model$betaf, `St.Error` = model$se.betaf)
          }
          if (is.null(coef_table)) next

          if (is.vector(coef_table)) {
            coef_table <- matrix(coef_table, ncol = 1,
                                 dimnames = list(names(coef_table), "Estimate"))
          }

          sigma_e <- NA
          if (!is.null(model_summary) && !is.null(model_summary$sigma.e)) {
            sigma_e <- model_summary$sigma.e
          } else if (!is.null(model$sigma.e)) {
            sigma_e <- model$sigma.e
          }

          if (iv %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
            all_coefs[[length(all_coefs) + 1]] <- data.frame(
              dependent   = dv,
              independent = iv,
              quantile    = as.numeric(qtl_str),
              k           = as.numeric(gsub("^k|^r", "", k_nm)),
              G           = g,
              estimate    = coef_table[iv, 1],
              std.error   = if (ncol(coef_table) >= 2) coef_table[iv, 2] else NA,
              p.value     = if (ncol(coef_table) >= 4) coef_table[iv, 4] else NA,
              sigma.e     = sigma_e,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(all_coefs) == 0) {
    warning("No coefficients extracted from qife_results")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  do.call(rbind, all_coefs)
}

# Set G of interest for tables/plots (headline spec: G = 4)
qife_results <- qife_results_G5 # Also change G here

qife_coefs_df <- extract_qife_coefficients(qife_results, g = 5) # CHANGE G HERE
#saveRDS(qife_coefs_df, file = "qife_coefs_df_annual_G3.rds")
#saveRDS(qife_coefs_df, file = "qife_coefs_df_annual_G4.rds")
#saveRDS(qife_coefs_df, file = "qife_coefs_df_annual_G5.rds")

# Visualisation of QIFE results
if (nrow(qife_coefs_df) == 0) {
  warning("Could not extract coefficients from qife_results.")
} else {
  qife_coefs_df <- qife_coefs_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p.value = ifelse(is.na(p.value) & !is.na(std.error) & std.error > 0,
                       2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(estimate / std.error))), p.value),
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.01 ~ "***",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05 ~ "**",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.1  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      dependent_label = factor(dependent,
        levels = c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread"),
        labels = c("2-Year Spread", "5-Year Spread", "10-Year Spread")),
      independent_label = factor(
        dplyr::case_when(
          grepl("BII_Weighted", independent) ~ "Biodiversity Degradation (BII)",
          grepl("BHI_Weighted", independent) ~ "Biodiversity Degradation (BHI)",
          grepl("^EPI", independent) ~ "Environmental Performance Index",
          grepl("NDGAIN", independent) ~ "Climate Vulnerability (ND-GAIN)",
          TRUE ~ independent
        ),
        levels = c("Biodiversity Degradation (BII)", "Biodiversity Degradation (BHI)",
                   "Environmental Performance Index", "Climate Vulnerability (ND-GAIN)")
      )
    )

  y_limits <- c(-0.3, 1.2)

  plot_qife <- function(data, k) {
    if (nrow(data) == 0) { warning(paste("No data for k=", k)); return(invisible(NULL)) }

    sigma_labels <- data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(dependent_label, independent_label) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        label = paste0("\u03c3 = ", sprintf("%.3f", mean(sigma.e, na.rm = TRUE))),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(x = 0.9, y = -Inf)

    ggplot(data, aes(x = quantile, y = estimate)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                      ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error), fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = significance), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      geom_text(data = sigma_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, color = "darkgray", fontface = "italic") +
      facet_grid(dependent_label ~ independent_label) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title    = "Asymmetric Impact of Nature-Related Financial Vulnerability (Annual)",
        subtitle = paste0("Quantile IFE with ", k, " PCA factor", if (k > 1) "s" else "",
                          ". Rightmost points represent high borrowing cost countries."),
        x = "Quantile", y = "Marginal Effect on Sovereign Bond Yield Spread (pp)",
        caption  = "Significance: *** p<0.01, ** p<0.05, * p<0.1. 95% confidence intervals from block-bootstrapped standard errors with 500 replications per quantile. \u03c3 = mean standard deviation of error terms. 57 countries, annual, 2000-2020."
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgray", color = NA),
        panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines"),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50"),
        axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = 9)
      )
  }

  if (!"k" %in% names(qife_coefs_df) && "r" %in% names(qife_coefs_df)) {
    qife_coefs_df$k <- qife_coefs_df$r
  }
  print(plot_qife(dplyr::filter(qife_coefs_df, k == 2), k = 2))
  print(plot_qife(dplyr::filter(qife_coefs_df, k == 1), k = 1))
}
```
